journeys.title: Your fatty-acid picture
journeys.measures: 11 fatty acids in a dried blood spot, with calculated ratios and indices.
journeys.boundary: A fatty-acid profile is not a diagnosis and does not establish a health benefit from supplementation.
journeys.availability: Zinzino states that BalanceTest is not available in New York. Confirm current availability before ordering.
steps: Frame the question
Decide what you want to learn about dietary fatty-acid exposure. You do not have to buy a test to start learning.
Understand the method
Read the manufacturer's current instructions. A dried-blood-spot profile and a red-blood-cell Omega-3 Index are not automatically interchangeable.
Read in context
Keep the sample date, method and units with the result. Take questions about interpretation to a qualified clinician.
Choose a follow-up
Discuss food, habits and whether another measurement would change a decision. A before-and-after result does not prove which change caused it.

journeys.title: Gut markers, with context
journeys.measures: Tryptophan, kynurenine and indole-3-propionic acid in a dried blood spot, plus calculated ratios and a manufacturer-defined index.
journeys.boundary: This is not a stool microbiome inventory, an allergy test, or a diagnosis of a digestive condition. An association between a marker and health is not proof that changing it improves health.
journeys.availability: The x2 listing contains two Gut Health Tests; it is not a fifth kind of test. Confirm location eligibility and current stock with Zinzino.
steps: Separate the questions
Distinguish curiosity about a biomarker from a symptom needing clinical assessment. Do not postpone care while waiting for a home test.
Know what is sampled
The manufacturer describes a blood-spot test, not stool sequencing. Follow the supplied collection and shipping instructions.
Keep uncertainty visible
A composite score does not map every organism or explain every symptom. Ask what evidence supports an action based on this particular report.
Review before repeating
Keep any repeat measurement comparable. Discuss whether repeat testing is useful, rather than assuming that every change requires another kit.

journeys.title: Vitamin D, without guesswork
journeys.measures: 25-hydroxyvitamin D, a blood marker used to assess vitamin D status.
journeys.boundary: Routine vitamin D screening is not recommended for every healthy adult. A result is not an automatic instruction to start or increase a supplement.
journeys.availability: Zinzino states that Vitamin D Test is not available in New York. Confirm current availability before ordering.
steps: Ask whether testing helps
The 2024 Endocrine Society guideline advises against routine screening in generally healthy adults without an established indication. Ask whether a result would change your care.
Check the details
Read the current collection instructions and keep the report's units. Nanograms per milliliter and nanomoles per liter are different units.
Discuss the whole picture
Bring your medicine and supplement list to the clinician interpreting the result. This website does not calculate a dose.
Agree on a plan
Follow-up timing depends on the clinical reason for testing. A manufacturer's retest interval is not a universal medical recommendation.

journeys.title: A longer view of blood sugar
journeys.measures: Glycated hemoglobin, which reflects average blood glucose over roughly the previous three months.
journeys.boundary: A home wellness result is not a standalone diagnosis. It does not show real-time glucose or every high and low, and several conditions can affect its interpretation.
journeys.availability: Zinzino states that HbA1c Test is not available in New York. Stock can change; check the official listing rather than relying on this guide.
steps: Start with your clinician
If you have symptoms, an existing diagnosis or questions about screening, use clinical care rather than a website pathway to choose a test.
Understand the timeframe
HbA1c is a longer-term marker. It cannot tell you your glucose level right now or show the effect of yesterday's meal.
Check interpretation limits
Anemia, hemoglobin variants and changes in red-cell lifespan can affect results. Tell your clinician about relevant conditions and medicines.
Follow up appropriately
Unexpected results need professional interpretation and sometimes confirmatory testing. Do not change prescribed medicines based on this page or a home report.
